verdict.rationale: Numeral is a tax-compliance SaaS/API product that exposes its own data as an MCP server for external AI agents to call (docs-7, docs-9, probe-3) — it is not itself an agent or agent-runtime that would consume other MCP servers' tools. The 'plug MCP servers into this product' framing is a category error for a backend compliance platform; no evidence pack item describes Numeral acting as an MCP client.
